mutations.label: statusline: a stale CI cache is said to be stale, not read as current
mutations.from: if (age > CI_STALE_MS) return { state: 'stale', ageMinutes: Math.round(age / 60_000) }

mutations.label: statusline: a red CI is not rendered green
statusline: the segment says when it was last observed
mutations.from: const age = typeof value?.ageMs === 'number' ? `last observed ${renderAge(value.ageMs)} ago` : null
mutations.only: ^(?:the segment follows the log: a count, a passed check, nothing edited, unknown, and could-not-look|the CLI reads the statusLine JSON from stdin, prints the segment, and never fails)$

mutations.label: evidence-flip: the status line says nothing positive from a torn log
mutations.only: ^(?:degrading the evidence changes the answer, at every surface that can give a positive one)$

mutations.label: inferred: the status line marks a tick a guessed check earned
mutations.only: ^(?:the status line marks a tick that an inferred check earned)$

mutations.label: statusline: a write the last observation does not cover outranks a pass
mutations.only: ^(?:the status line: a write the last observation does not cover outranks a pass|a write appended after the observation in the same millisecond is still uncovered)$

mutations.label: statusline: a late baseline says since when nothing was edited
mutations.only: ^(?:a baseline adopted partway through a session does not speak for the whole of it)$

mutations.label: statusline: covered is decided by position in the log, not by a timestamp that can tie
mutations.only: ^(?:a write appended after the observation in the same millisecond is still uncovered)$

mutations.label: §348 review: the statusline counts unread workflows as jobs
mutations.only: ^a workflow whose jobs were not read is counted apart from jobs$
